description: Cross-repo compatibility matrix (#466). A record kept for people and release notes: no CI in kpubdata, kpubdata-builder or kpubdata-studio reads it to gate a dependency range (#788). tests/unit/test_compatibility_json.py checks its shape, that the supported row is the pin docs/compatibility.md states, and that this package's version is not behind it. The supported row is Builder's pin and moves with the application release (docs/compatibility.md 5.1), so right after a kpubdata release the package is ahead of it.
update_policy: Updated with the Builder and Studio release, after Builder's pin has moved to the new kpubdata (docs/compatibility.md 5.1). Builder/Studio link here, never copy.

matrix.note: 0.8.0 released 2026-09-30. Licence fields, schema(), provenance, validation report.
Cross-repo E2E (#282) runs against main branches

2026-09 release. Builder and Studio share one version (kpubdata ADR 0004); the kpubdata column is what uv.lock pinned, not the declared range (>=0.6.0,<0.7). kpubdata 0.7.0 is outside this release; builder main moved to >=0.7.0,<0.8 in builder#746, and the next release adds its own row.
